scope: D12c resident full-norm rows versus D13 certified-sketch/exact-replay rows
claim_boundary: This certificate checks source-level correspondence at the frozen commits and binds it to finite differential/runtime tests. It is not a whole-program formal equivalence proof.

mappings.reference: enumerate_hypercube: x/y/z/w nested loops, sign representatives, divisibility-by-2/3 filters, order-four symmetry filter, exact Gram evaluation, odd-norm admission
mappings.candidate: enumerate_hypercube: identical loops and filters; finduv_eval_norm performs the same quadratic form and exact division before the same odd-norm admission
mappings.failure: A nonzero division remainder or nonpositive exact norm returns ID2ISO_STATUS_FATAL; capacity/sketch failure is fatal.

mappings.reference: finduv_sort_permutation orders original enumeration indices by (full norm, original index)
mappings.candidate: finduv_compare_indices orders by bit length, leading 64 bits, replayed exact norm on a sketch tie, then original index
mappings.failure: A replay error latches context.fatal; the temporary index fallback cannot be published because finduv_sort_permutation then fails the row.

mappings.reference: j1 increases from 0; j2 increases from j1; diagonal aliases row 1; non-diagonal regenerates row 2
mappings.candidate: the same triangular loops and alias/regeneration rule
mappings.failure: A regeneration error or a count differing from the validation pass is fatal before pair search.

mappings.reference: i1 increases from 0; i2 starts at i1 on the diagonal and at 0 otherwise
mappings.candidate: find_uv_from_compact_lists uses the same i1 and starting_index2/i2 loops
mappings.failure: An exact norm regeneration failure is fatal.

mappings.reference: for invertible n2 modulo n1, v starts at (T mod n1) n2^{-1} mod n1 and advances by n1 while v < floor(T/n2)
mappings.candidate: the same ibz_invmod, modular representative, quotient bound, and v += n1 sequence; production passes number_sum_square=0
mappings.failure: Nonexact or nonpositive reconstructed u is fatal; a noninvertible pair continues; exhaustion is NotFound.

mappings.reference: publish only after a positive list status and validate ideal membership; propagate negative status to fatal cleanup
mappings.candidate: the same positive-status publication structure plus selected exact norms; all terminal paths join workspace clearing
mappings.failure: Success, NotFound, and Fatal all finalize active objects and clear the complete find_uv workspace.
